scenario.labor: Independent repair shop or marque specialist

longevity.label: Longevity
longevity.description: Whole-platform durability potential under appropriate scheduled maintenance, covering engine, transmission, cooling, electrical systems and structural corrosion. Age-related renewal is recorded separately. Not the remaining life of an unidentified used car.
anchors: Exceptional platform durability with well-supported evidence across major systems.
Above-average durability with identifiable, manageable risks.
Average durability with meaningful upkeep dependencies or a documented major weak point.
Below average. Several documented consequential vulnerabilities or a difficult-to-control failure mode.
Poor durability supported by evidence of recurring major problems across the applicable configuration.

ownershipCost.label: Low upkeep
ownershipCost.description: Affordability to maintain under the U.S. 3,000-mile/year independent-shop scenario. Higher is better. Excludes fuel, insurance, purchase, tax, financing and depreciation.
anchors: Very low. Inexpensive common consumables, accessible service and modest documented repair exposure.
Low. Common service and parts, with some specialist work or expensive exceptions.
Moderate. A recurring specialist job, performance consumables or a meaningful repair reserve.
High. Multiple specialist or access-intensive jobs, expensive hardware or a material catastrophic exposure.
Very high. Broad specialist dependence with costly components and major repair exposure.

drivingEnjoyment.label: Driving enjoyment
drivingEnjoyment.description: Editorial assessment of feedback, involvement and character on public roads.
anchors: Benchmark feedback and involvement in multiple controls, with a characterful powertrain or exceptional agility.
Rewarding balance and involvement with a clear limitation in feedback, response, or accessibility.
Engaging in a particular way but with meaningful compromises across several controls.
Competent and agreeable with modest feedback or involvement.
Little chassis or powertrain involvement based on the tested configuration.

aesthetics.label: Editorial aesthetics
aesthetics.description: Assessor taste, separate from factual design observations; no votes and no objective beauty claim.
anchors: Exceptional proportions, coherence and distinctive identity with few reservations.
Distinctive and coherent with one or two visible compromises.
Appealing overall with mixed detailing or familiar proportions.
Conventional proportions and limited visual identity.
Incoherent proportions or details dominate the editorial impression.

precision: Use the published broad anchors by default; adjustments require a separate cited explanation and reviewed comparison.
referencePopulation: The 200 U.S.-focused catalog configurations, including mainstream reference vehicles, under appropriate scheduled maintenance. These are editorial tiers, not percentiles or population measurements.
